prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted results, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.8% and -9.0%).
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) delivered inconsistent results with strong wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) alongside severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%), while story stage redesigns (choose_path, redesign) had 3 wins alongside 2 losses.
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 7 tests despite 2 wins (+3.6% and +6.5%), and categories with fewer agreeing tests remain thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Full Bleed Layout: Redesign adoption certificate screen to a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing pet certificate details. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with high mean duration (1017s); a streamlined full-bleed showcase improves visual clarity.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Companion Overview Screen: Introduce a dedicated overview screen right before path selection to explain different companion journey types. (why: While initial path conversion is 92.8%, mean time spent is high (514s), indicating users deliberate without full context.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Preview Flow: Add interactive companion audio and visual preview components directly on the pet selection screen. (why: Adoption stage takes median 89s / mean 1017s and has a drop-off of over 21%, benefiting from interactive preview reassurance.)
3: [finish, layout] Home Intro Compact Layout: Switch final home intro step to a compact layout for quicker onboarding completion. (why: Finish conversion is 75.5% with high completion duration (median 395s, mean 5815s), so simplifying layout reduces friction.)
4: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Ready System Notification Opt-In: Add an explicit system notification toggle on the waiting screen when custom pet processing completes. (why: Home stage waiting step has long wait times (mean 2336s), leading users to leave the desktop window inactive.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Hint: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in retains pet save data across sessions. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
6: [adoption, hint] Upload Photo Lighting Guidance Hint: Display photo upload guidance specifying good lighting and high contrast photo requirements. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom results.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Docking Progress Indicator: Enable progress bar and step counter on the waiting screen during desktop companion preparation. (why: Users wait median 201s / mean 2336s on home wait stage without active progress feedback.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign story introduction screen into a stage layout focusing on initial pet narrative context. (why: Story screen redesigns historically yielded successful wins, aiding user engagement before path choice.)
